notes.title: THANK YOU!
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for wishlisting, telling your friends about, and hopefully enjoying CATALYST. 
That being said... OOPS Might have overtuned it a bit, That is to say a certain boss (you probably know the one) Is a smidge too hard (Harder than the final boss) 

You can expect a balance patch SOON, and probably a few bugfixes along with it
until then though, Try your best to avoid a certain boss' shotgun and DASH DASH DASH!!!

Have a good one, and enjoy my game :) -SYDES
